datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify food insecurity conditions using the IPC methodology. Geographic data representing IPC classification phases were compiled for Honduras in near-term projection scenarios for October-December 2020, capturing spatial variation in acute food insecurity vulnerability.
